paper.title: MaD-RSI: Model-as-Data for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of agent harnesses has emerged as an effective approach to enhancing the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents. By searching the harness space for a specific LLM on a given dataset, RSI can discover a harness tailored to the capabilities and behavioral characteristics of that model. However, such optimization often creates a strong coupling between the learned harness and its target LLM, limiting generalization across models and requiring substantial

summary.core_problem: 现有的 Agent Harness（代理脚手架/框架）递归自我改进（RSI）方法通常仅针对单一目标 LLM 进行优化，导致 Harness 与特定模型强耦合，泛化性差，且迁移到新模型成本高昂。
summary.importance: 提出了一种“模型即数据”（Models-as-Data）的新视角，将不同 LLM 的行为差异作为优化共享 Harness 的训练证据，而不是仅仅作为评估泛化性的指标。这为构建跨模型通用、可复用的 Agent 框架提供了一种新思路，有助于降低多模型适配的开发成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MaD-RSI 框架。核心机制包括：1) 将不同模型在不同推理配置下的响应组织成结构化张量；2) 基于模型间的分歧和响应模式的覆盖率来选择信息量大的 query；3) 联合诊断对齐的成功和失败轨迹，以指导 Harness 的后续修订。通过这种方式，优化出一个可以独立用于不同 LLM 的单一共享 Harness。
summary.experiments: 在法律推理、代码生成、医学推理和 Agent 安全任务上，跨多个异构 LLM 进行了评估。引入了 success coverage 和 joint success 两个群体指标。结果表明，MaD-RSI 在某些设置下提升了跨模型性能和迁移能力，并在通用任务上降低了累积训练成本。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中关于“Models-as-Data”视角的阐述，以及 MaD-RSI 框架中如何利用模型分歧进行证据选择（evidence selection）的设计。这对于理解如何利用多模型反馈来提升系统鲁棒性有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods for agent harnesses typically optimize for a single target LLM, resulting in strong coupling, poor generalization across models, and high costs for adapting to new models.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a 'Models-as-Data' perspective, utilizing behavioral differences among heterogeneous LLMs as training evidence to optimize a shared harness, rather than merely as a metric for evaluating generalization. This provides a novel approach for building cross-model, reusable agent frameworks and reducing adaptation costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the MaD-RSI framework. Core mechanisms include: 1) organizing responses from different models under various inference configurations into a structured tensor; 2) selecting informative queries based on model disagreement and coverage of response patterns; 3) jointly diagnosing aligned successful and failed trajectories to guide harness revisions. This optimizes a single shared harness applicable to different LLMs independently.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on legal reasoning, code generation, medical reasoning, and agent safety tasks across heterogeneous LLMs. Introduced two population measures: success coverage and joint success. Results indicate that MaD-RSI improves cross-model performance and transferability in certain settings, and reduces cumulative training costs on general tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the 'Models-as-Data' perspective in the Introduction and the evidence selection mechanism based on model disagreement in the MaD-RSI framework. This provides insights into leveraging multi-model feedback to enhance system robustness.

recommendation.zh: 读方法设定即可；把模型差异当训练样本的想法干净，实验若只换几个 API 模型则信号偏弱。
recommendation.en: Read the setup: treating model variation as training data is clean, but the signal is weak if experiments only swap a few API models.

paper.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
paper.abstract: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-d

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 model-harness co-evolution 中的“脑-身不匹配”：模型参数已经学到的行为，和外部 harness 提供的工具接口、状态管理、控制流之间发生漂移。典型问题包括模型输出 XML 但 harness 期待 JSON，或者 harness 引入新的上下文管理工具而当前模型不会稳定使用。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent post-training / harness optimization。但它对“模型能力不是孤立存在的”这个问题有启发：模型 checkpoint、工具接口、提示协议、执行流程需要共同演化。对持续训练、agent SFT/RL、工具使用数据构造有参考意义，尤其是如何选择历史 checkpoint 作为适配起点，而不是默认从最新模型继续训练。
summary.technical_approach: CoEvo-RSI 维护一个 evolutionary archive，保存历史 harness、模型 checkpoint、开发记录和执行反馈。每一轮先由 Curator 整理当前 agent 的执行失败信息，再让 harness editors 从历史设计中选择起点并生成多个 offspring harness。随后系统为每个候选 harness 选择或合并历史模型 checkpoint，形成候选 model-harness pair。经过评测后，选出较好的组合，在对应 harness 下继续做模型适配；验证通过的 pair 进入下一轮，相关轨迹和 checkpoint 再写回 archive。核心点不是单向地“先改 harness 再训模型”，而是让 harness 继承历史结构经验，同时让模型继承与新 harness 更匹配的历史能力。论文还提出 TIMR，即 turn-level interface mismatch rate，用于低成本监控可观测的接口违规。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 multi-agent failure attribution、home care、SQL 三类任务。摘要中给出的关键结果是：co-evolved Qwen3.5-9B 在 Who&When Pro 上比 Qwen3.8-Max 高 4.40 agent accuracy；在 TraceElephant 上比 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 高 14.16 agent accuracy。结果主要支持两个判断：一是 harness 演化单独做容易产生接口和能力错配；二是从 archive 中选择或合并更合适的历史 checkpoint，可以比直接沿用最新 checkpoint 更稳。需要注意，给定材料中没有完整列出每个任务的数据规模、轮数、K 个 offspring 的具体设置和适配训练细节，精确复现仍需看实验配置表与附录。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 brain-body mismatch 的定义和两个例子，再看 Method 中 archive、Curator、harness editors、checkpoint selection/merging 的流程图。实验部分重点看三类任务的主表、TIMR 与最终 agent accuracy 的关系、以及是否有 ablation 区分“只演化 harness”“只继续训练模型”“使用历史 checkpoint 继承”。如果关心预训练接口，可重点思考 checkpoint merging/selection 是否能迁移到 continual pretrain 或 tool-use mid-training。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies brain-body mismatch in model-harness co-evolution. The model is the “brain”; the harness is the execution scaffold that defines tools, action formats, memory, prompts, and control flow. As both sides evolve, the harness may demand behaviors the current model has not learned, or it may fail to use capabilities already present in older checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding the interface between model adaptation and agent scaffolding. The main lesson is that checkpoint lineage matters: the latest checkpoint is not always the best initialization for a newly evolved execution protocol. This connects to continual training, tool-use adaptation, and post-training data design, where the training target is shaped by an external execution environment.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoEvo-RSI keeps an archive of previous harnesses, model checkpoints, development histories, and execution outcomes. In each generation, a Curator summarizes execution feedback from the current agent. Harness editors then browse the archive, choose historical harness designs, and develop offspring harnesses. For each offspring, the framework selects or merges historical checkpoints to build candidate model-harness pairs. These candidates are evaluated, one pair is adapted under its harness, and a validation step decides which pair is promoted to the next generation. The paper also introduces TIMR, a turn-level interface mismatch rate, as a cheap diagnostic for observable interface violations.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers multi-agent failure attribution, home care, and SQL tasks. The headline results reported in the provided content are that a co-evolved Qwen3.5-9B outperforms Qwen3.8-Max by 4.40 agent accuracy on Who&When Pro, and outperforms DeepSeek-V4-Pro by 14.16 agent accuracy on TraceElephant. The empirical claim is that bidirectional inheritance is better than treating harness evolution and model adaptation as loosely coupled steps. The provided excerpt does not include all implementation details, such as exact adaptation data size, number of generations, offspring count, or checkpoint merging recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the problem formulation in the introduction, then inspect the CoEvo-RSI pipeline figure and the method description of archive-based inheritance. In the experiments, focus on ablations that separate harness-only evolution, model-only adaptation, and historical checkpoint selection or merging. For LLM training researchers, the most relevant part is not the agent benchmark result itself, but the checkpoint-selection logic under a changing execution interface.

recommendation.zh: 只看框架图和 ablation：它提醒 scaffold 不是免费午餐，模型选择和 harness 演化要一起控。
recommendation.en: Read the framework and ablations: it is a useful reminder that scaffold evolution is not free, and model selection must be coupled to the harness.

paper.title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
paper.abstract: Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible. Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments. However, the space of possible design choices in ML is vast. An LLM that proposes an experiment needs a reliable intuition of whether it is worth running given the timing constraints of long training runs. In this work, we measure such intuition in current frontier LLMs by evaluating how accurately they predict th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“LLM 能不能提出 ML 实验想法”，而是更具体的一步：在真正跑训练之前，LLM 能不能对自己提出的实验改动形成可校准的结果预期。这个问题对 autoresearch 和递归式自改进很关键，因为实验提出很便宜，训练和验证很贵；如果模型对实验收益没有基本判断，搜索过程就会把大量算力浪费在低价值分支上。论文把这个能力定义为对实验 outcome 的数值预测能力，而不是二选一偏好判断，因此关注的是幅度、方向、校准误差和排序能力，而不只是“是否更喜欢某个方案”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接提出新的训练方法，但它触到一个很实际的接口问题：未来很多 pretrain recipe、数据配比、优化器改动、mid-train 决策，可能先由模型提出，再由系统筛选。此时需要的不是泛泛的“idea generation”，而是对实验价值的先验估计。论文的贡献主要有两层。第一，给出一个可操作的评测框架，把“实验直觉”从模糊概念变成可测量对象。第二，结果显示当前前沿模型在这个问题上只有有限能力：通常能弱于或略高于随机地把握方向，但远谈不上可靠的实验价值评估器。这对自动化研究系统是个约束条件，也提示后续若想让 LLM 参与 pretrain 设计，可能需要显式训练 value model、实验回报模型，或者把历史实验轨迹纳入专门的后训练阶段。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较干净。作者从 MLE-bench Lite 的 8 个 Kaggle 风格任务出发，先选一个处于 leaderboard 中游的 baseline，保证既有上升空间，也有下降空间。然后让同一个 LLM 先提出一个改动 idea，再实现它、训练它、得到真实分数。这个过程从 baseline 和后续节点递归展开成一棵小树：根节点提出 4 个想法，每个子节点再提出 2 个 follow-up idea，总共每棵树 12 个 idea。三种 proposing/implementing 模型分别是 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、Kimi K3；8 个任务 × 3 个模型 × 12 个 idea 得到 288 个实验，去掉失败项后分析 269 个。核心评测不是直接比较原始分数，因为任务指标尺度不同，作者把每个 idea 的真实改变量按任务内标准差 σ 做标准化，并统一符号，使正值总表示改进。预测值也做同样标准化。这样可以在 log loss、AUC、RMSE 之间汇总。论文随后从几个维度评估：数值误差、相关性、方向判断、不同 reasoning level、不同 prompt context、不同实现模型，以及是否存在 self-preference。这里一个值得注意的设计是，作者让模型有一半概率被要求提出“改进”想法，另一半提出“变差”想法，不是为了制造坏样本，而是为了让 outcome 分布更均衡，避免评测只落在小幅正改动附近。相比以往只做 pairwise selection 的工作，这里更接近真实实验管理，因为研究系统需要估计 expected value，而不是只在两个候选中选一个。
summary.experiments: 数据规模不大，但实验组织方式有信息量。最终分析集是 269 个已运行 idea，覆盖 8 个任务和 5 个预测模型。论文的主结论是：当前模型对实验结果的数值预测能力有限，能提供一些弱信号，但误差和校准问题都比较明显。它们通常比纯随机猜测更接近真实结果，也能在一定程度上区分更可能有效和更可能无效的改动，但这种能力不足以单独承担高成本实验筛选。作者还做了几类消融。第一，提升 reasoning level 或增加上下文，并没有稳定带来明显改善，说明瓶颈不只是“想得不够久”或“信息不够多”，而更像是缺少关于训练动态和经验回报的内化模型。第二，idea 由谁实现会影响真实 outcome，但预测模型对这种 implementation variance 的把握有限。第三，测试 self-preference 后，模型对自己家族提出的 idea 可能存在偏好或更乐观的估计，不过从摘要和给出的正文片段看，这种效应更像次要现象，不是主导结论。论文里最有价值的不是某个单点数字，而是误差分解：模型往往能讲出看似合理的机制，但对收益幅度缺乏稳定刻度，尤其难以识别那些“听起来对、实际没用”或“局部合理但全局不增益”的工程改动。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看方法部分里数据构造流程和标准化定义，尤其是 idea tree、任务选择、σ 标准化和 improve/worsen 双向采样，这几处决定了评测是否可信。然后看结果部分里三类表：一类是整体预测误差和相关性，一类是 reasoning/context 消融，一类是 implementing model 与 self-preference 分析。阅读时建议带着两个问题。第一，作者测到的到底是“ML 直觉”，还是“对 benchmark 局部模式的语言化猜测”；第二，数值预测失败主要来自方向错、幅度错，还是任务间不可比。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线。如果要深挖，重点看附录中的 idea 示例和失败案例，它们更能说明模型为什么会高估某些常见 recipe 改动。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more operational question than “can LLMs generate ML ideas?”: before running a training job, can an LLM predict the outcome of its own proposed experiment with meaningful calibration? This matters for autoresearch and recursive self-improvement because ideation is cheap while training is slow and expensive. If a model cannot estimate whether an idea is likely to help, hurt, or do nothing, an automated research loop will waste most of its budget on low-value branches. The paper therefore evaluates numerical outcome prediction, not just pairwise preference, so the target is direction, magnitude, ranking, and calibration.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to pretraining research infrastructure. Many future decisions around data mixture, optimizer changes, annealing schedules, or mid-training interventions may be proposed by models and filtered by another model. That requires an experiment-value prior, not just idea generation. The contribution is twofold. First, it turns “ML intuition” into a measurable object with a concrete benchmark protocol. Second, the results suggest current frontier models provide only weak and unreliable signals about experiment value. That is a useful constraint for anyone building automated recipe search or LLM-in-the-loop pretraining systems. It also points toward a likely missing component: explicit value models trained on historical experiment trajectories rather than relying on generic language-model reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is fairly clean. The authors start from 8 tasks in MLE-bench Lite, each with a baseline solution chosen near the middle of the leaderboard so there is room to improve or degrade. An LLM proposes a modification, implements it, runs training, and obtains the actual score. This process is expanded into a small tree: 4 ideas from the baseline, then 2 follow-up ideas from each resulting node, giving 12 ideas per tree. Three models act as proposer-implementers: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Kimi K3. Across 8 tasks and 3 proposer models, this yields 288 ideas, with 269 retained after failed runs and unusable predictions are removed. Because the tasks use different metrics and scales, the paper normalizes each realized score change by the within-task standard deviation of realized changes, and flips signs so positive always means improvement. Predicted changes are normalized the same way. This allows pooling across log-loss, ROC-AUC, and RMSE tasks. The evaluation then looks at numerical error, correlation, directional accuracy, the effect of more reasoning or more context, the effect of the implementing model, and self-preference. A particularly good design choice is the improve/worsen prompting split: half the ideas are intended to improve and half to worsen, not to create trivial bad examples, but to avoid a one-sided outcome distribution concentrated near small positive gains. Compared with prior work on pairwise selection, this is closer to real experiment management, where one needs an expected-value estimate rather than a binary preference.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset is modest in size but informative in structure: 269 executed ideas, 8 tasks, and 5 predictor models. The main result is that current models have limited ability to predict numerical outcomes of ML experiments. They appear to do better than naive guessing and can extract some weak signal about which ideas are more promising, but the errors and calibration issues are large enough that they are not reliable stand-alone experiment filters. The ablations are useful. Increasing reasoning level or adding more prompt context does not produce a robust improvement, which suggests the bottleneck is not simply insufficient deliberation or missing local context. It looks more like the models lack an internalized model of training dynamics and empirical payoff. The identity of the implementing model matters for realized outcomes, but predictor models only partially account for that implementation variance. The paper also probes self-preference, asking whether models are more optimistic about ideas from their own family; this seems secondary rather than the main story. The most useful takeaway is not a single headline metric but the error pattern: models often generate plausible mechanistic explanations for why an idea should help, yet they lack a stable scale for expected gain and struggle with changes that sound reasonable but have little empirical effect.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the dataset construction and normalization details: the idea-tree generation process, task selection, sigma normalization, and the improve/worsen sampling scheme. Those choices determine whether the benchmark is measuring anything coherent. Then read the main result tables covering overall prediction quality, reasoning/context ablations, and the implementing-model plus self-preference analyses. Two questions are worth keeping in mind. First, is the benchmark measuring genuine ML intuition or only language-level pattern matching over familiar benchmark recipes? Second, when prediction fails, is the dominant issue wrong sign, wrong magnitude, or poor comparability across tasks? Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you want more depth, the appendix examples and failure cases are the best place to inspect what kinds of ideas are systematically overestimated.

recommendation.zh: 一个有趣的评测视角，量化了LLM作为'AI Researcher'预测实验结果的能力（直觉），对关注AI Scientist和自动化研究闭环的同学有启发。
recommendation.en: An interesting evaluation perspective quantifying LLMs' ability (intuition) to predict experiment outcomes as 'AI Researchers', inspiring for those focusing on AI Scientists and automated research loops.

paper.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate AI research, including language-model (LM) development, offering a potential path toward recursive self-improvement. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是“如何让语言模型从过往模型开发实验中学会提出更有效的改进方案”，并且把这种能力迁移到新的模型族和训练配置上。难点不在于让 agent 执行实验，而在于让 proposer 形成稳定的研究判断。若直接用真实训练实验做 RL 奖励，成本高到不可用；若改用代理奖励，策略优化又会迅速利用代理模型的高估偏差，导致奖励上升但真实收益下降。论文聚焦的核心问题，就是在极高实验成本下，如何构造一个既便宜、又能随策略分布变化保持可信的训练信号，用来训练“会改进语言模型的语言模型”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“LM 开发经验”显式转成可学习对象，而不是只做 in-context 检索或静态实验数据库查询，这对自动化 recipe 搜索、架构搜索、训练目标搜索都有直接启发。第二，它提出的研究 world model + on-policy calibration 结构，本质上是在高成本真实反馈场景下做可扩展 RL，这和预训练中的数据筛选、训练配方搜索、mid-train 决策优化有相通之处。第三，这篇工作的价值更多在方法框架，而不是某个单点技巧：它说明只靠离线实验记录训练一个评分器是不够的，必须持续把当前策略真正偏好的 proposal 拉回真实执行分布上校准，否则会出现典型的 reward hacking。对做 pretrain 自动化和 closed-loop model development 的人，这个判断很重要。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，LM2LM 把自动化 LM 开发形式化为一个 sequential decision problem。每个任务对应一个目标模型家族、参数规模、训练预算和 reference config；proposer 负责生成自然语言 proposal，builder 把 proposal 转成可执行修改，执行后得到相对 reference 的验证损失改变量。训练目标不是直接预测实验结果，而是用 RL 提升 proposer 生成高收益 proposal 的能力。

为了解决真实奖励昂贵的问题，作者引入 Research World Model, RWM。它不是单独训练的回归器，而是一个冻结的大语言模型，输入包括任务描述、reference 配置、历史实验记录以及候选 proposal，输出该 proposal 相对 baseline 的预期 gain。也就是说，RWM 通过 in-context experimental records 来做 outcome prediction，再把预测 gain 变成 RL reward。这样避免了为每个 proposal 都跑一次完整训练。

但作者的重点不只是“用 LLM 当 reward model”，而是处理分布漂移。随着 proposer 经 RL 更新，它会越来越倾向于生成 RWM 评分高、但历史记录覆盖不足的 proposal。固定记录下的 RWM 会在这些区域系统性高估，RL 随后放大这种偏差。为此，LM2LM 引入 on-policy calibration：周期性地从当前策略生成的 proposal 中，挑选 RWM 排名靠前的一部分做真实执行，把测得的真实 gain 追加进 RWM 的上下文知识，再继续训练。这个设计有两个关键点。其一，不是随机补数据，而是专门校准当前策略最可能 exploit 的高分区域；其二，不重新训练 reward model，而是通过更新 in-context records 让冻结 LLM 的判断重新锚定到真实结果。

从方法取舍看，这比纯离线 preference learning 更适合高成本实验环境，因为它把真实执行预算集中花在“最危险的误差区域”；也比全量在线 RL 便宜得多，因为绝大多数 proposal 仍由 RWM 评估。论文还分析了 RWM 的 ranking quality，说明在这类任务里，排序能力比绝对数值回归更关键，RL 只需要相对好坏足够稳定即可。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕 held-out LM development environments 展开，核心评估是 proposer 生成的改进方案在真实执行后的收益。文中给出一个很直观的成本量级：训练 486M 参数模型、8B tokens 的一次实验约需 45 B200 GPU-hours；若用 GRPO 风格设置做 100 次更新、每次 32 个 state、每个 state 采样 8 个 proposal，总共需要 25,600 次 proposal 评估，若全靠真实执行，约 1,152,000 GPU-hours，成本超过 1600 万美元。这个量级解释了为何必须依赖代理反馈。

结果上，LM2LM 在真实执行评测中优于仅依赖历史记录的 baseline，也优于强 in-context baseline；作者还声称训练后的 Qwen3.8-27B proposer 在 held-out 环境上超过 GPT-6-sol。更重要的是分析结果：RWM 在初始阶段能提供有信息量的 proposal 排序；若不做 on-policy calibration，随着 RL 推进，固定记录 RWM 的排序质量持续恶化，最终比随机排序还差；加入 calibration 后，过估计被明显抑制，ranking quality 大体保持，真实收益也随之保住。论文的关键消融应包括：只用真实记录做 ICL、不做 RL；用 RWM 奖励但不校准；校准频率和执行预算变化；以及不同 proposal 选择策略对校准效果的影响。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从叙述看，作者最看重的不是单次平均分，而是“代理奖励与真实收益是否持续对齐”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 里关于成本的算例和 Fig.1，它把问题设定讲得很清楚：真实反馈太贵，静态代理会被策略利用。第二，看 Method 中 RWM 和 on-policy calibration 的定义，重点理解为什么校准对象必须来自当前策略的高分 proposal，而不是历史数据的随机补充。第三，看分析实验里 ranking quality 随训练推进的变化，这部分决定了方法是否真的解决了 surrogate drift。

如果时间有限，建议先读问题设定、算法流程图、主结果表和 calibration 消融，预计 25-35 分钟能抓住主线。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 RWM 作为冻结 LLM + in-context records 的形式，和单独训练 reward model 相比到底依赖了哪些语言模型先验；二是这种框架能否迁移到预训练 recipe 搜索、数据配比搜索、mid-training 决策等更贴近基座训练的场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to train an LLM to make better LM-development decisions from past experimental feedback, and to generalize that judgment to new model families and training setups. The bottleneck is not execution ability but research judgment: which modification is worth trying under a tight experiment budget. Direct RL on real outcomes is prohibitively expensive because each proposal may require a full training run. Pure surrogate rewards are cheap, but policy optimization quickly exploits surrogate overestimation under distribution shift. The central problem is therefore how to build a low-cost reward signal that remains trustworthy as the proposal policy changes.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is methodological rather than domain-specific. It treats LM-development experience as a learnable capability, not just something retrieved in context. That matters for automated recipe search, architecture search, optimizer selection, and other expensive pretraining decisions. The paper also gives a concrete design for RL under costly real-world feedback: use a model-based surrogate for scale, then spend limited real executions to recalibrate exactly where the current policy is likely to exploit errors. That lesson transfers beyond AutoResearch. It is directly useful for any closed-loop system where training decisions are expensive and reward hacking against a learned evaluator is a real risk.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LM2LM formulates automated LM development as a sequential decision problem. Each environment specifies a target model family, size, training budget, and a reference configuration. A proposer LLM generates natural-language modification proposals; a builder converts them into executable changes; execution returns the gain relative to the reference validation loss. The proposer is trained with RL to generate proposals with higher expected gains.

The key scalability device is a Research World Model (RWM). Instead of executing every proposal, LM2LM uses a frozen LLM to predict the gain of a candidate proposal conditioned on the task description, the reference setup, and a set of prior experimental records provided in context. These predicted gains become RL rewards. This is not just a generic reward model. The design relies on the frozen LLM’s ability to reason over structured experimental history and produce useful relative rankings among proposals.

The more important contribution is how the paper handles reward drift. As the proposer improves, it shifts toward proposals that score highly under the RWM but may lie outside the support of the initial experimental records. A fixed surrogate then becomes vulnerable to systematic overestimation, and RL amplifies that error. LM2LM addresses this with on-policy calibration: at intervals during training, it takes a subset of high-scoring proposals from the current policy, executes them for real, and appends the measured outcomes to the RWM context. This keeps the surrogate grounded on exactly the region of proposal space that matters for the current policy.

That choice is deliberate. Randomly collecting more experiments would be wasteful. Re-training a separate reward model after each batch would also be heavier. By updating the in-context evidence of a frozen LLM, the method concentrates real-execution budget on the most decision-critical and most exploitable proposals. The paper further argues that ranking quality matters more than perfectly calibrated scalar prediction: for RL, preserving the relative ordering of proposals is often enough.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments evaluate proposal quality in held-out LM-development environments using real execution. The paper gives a useful cost calculation: training a 486M-parameter model on 8B tokens takes about 45 B200 GPU-hours. A GRPO-style setup with 100 updates, 32 states per update, and 8 proposals per state would require 25,600 proposal evaluations. If all were executed directly, that would cost about 1,152,000 GPU-hours, or more than $16M. This establishes why surrogate-based training is necessary.

Empirically, LM2LM outperforms baselines that rely only on past experimental records, and it also beats strong in-context approaches on real executed gains. The paper additionally claims that a Qwen3.8-27B proposer trained with LM2LM surpasses GPT-6-sol on held-out environments. The most informative results are the analyses of surrogate reliability. Early in training, the RWM provides useful proposal rankings. Without on-policy calibration, ranking quality degrades as RL progresses, eventually becoming worse than random because the policy learns to exploit overestimated regions. With calibration, overestimation is reduced and ranking quality is largely preserved, which in turn preserves real-world gains. The critical ablations are the no-RL baseline, RWM reward without calibration, calibration frequency and budget, and the strategy for selecting which proposals to execute.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the problem setup and the cost argument in the introduction. That section makes the motivation precise. Second, read the method section on the RWM and on-policy calibration, especially the rationale for calibrating high-ranked proposals from the current policy rather than sampling randomly. Third, inspect the analysis of ranking quality over training. That is where the paper either succeeds or fails.

A 25-35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main idea if you read the setup, the algorithm figure, the main results table, and the calibration ablations. The deeper questions worth following up are whether a frozen LLM plus in-context records is enough because of strong prior knowledge about ML experiments, and how well this framework would transfer to more direct pretraining decisions such as data-mixture search, optimizer schedules, or mid-training interventions.

recommendation.zh: 方向是对的：把“改进 LM”本身做成可训练策略；但先盯住 surrogate reward 被 exploit 到什么程度，若真实回报校准不硬，这类结果很容易自嗨。
recommendation.en: The direction is right—turning LM improvement into a trainable policy—but the whole paper lives or dies on how badly the surrogate reward gets exploited and how hard the real-feedback calibration is.

paper.title: Recursive Reward Improvement via Adversarial Meta-Prompt Evolution
paper.abstract: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) has gained wide attention for its ability to work with limited data. In a proposer-solver loop, a proposer model writes training tasks and a solver model learns to solve them through reinforcement learning. Such loops have succeeded in mathematics and coding, where every answer can be checked automatically. Open-ended expert tasks, like clinical report generations, have no answer key, which makes simple question-answer generation not viable. Here the proposer mus

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理开放式专家任务中的自生成奖励问题。数学和代码任务可以用最终答案、执行结果或单元测试检查，但临床报告、法律分析、金融建议这类开放式任务没有天然答案 key。模型可以同时生成任务和 rubric，但粗糙 rubric 往往不完整、表述含糊，solver 很容易写出看似命中评分点、实际内容错误或空洞的答案。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train/RL 数据闭环。但它对“模型自己产生训练信号”这个问题有清楚价值。论文把 reward hacking 从训练后的副作用，前移成生成奖励时的监督信号：先让模型攻击自己写的 rubric，再修补 rubric，最后才让 solver 学习。这一点对 RL pretrain、持续自训练和合成指令数据都相关，因为这些流程都会遇到同一个问题：生成数据容易，生成不被模型利用的评分规则更难。它没有解决开放式任务的真实性来源问题，但给了一个比直接生成 rubric 更稳的工程框架。
summary.technical_approach: RRI 由五个角色组成：proposer 生成任务和带权 rubric；adversary 生成专门利用 rubric 漏洞的答案；judge 按 rubric 给答案打分；solver 用这些奖励训练；meta-optimizer 读取训练反馈和已确认 exploit，改写 proposer 的任务与 rubric 生成指令。每个任务包含请求 x 和 rubric R={(c_j,p_j)}，其中 c_j 是评分准则，p_j 是 [-10,10] 内非零权重，正权重奖励应包含内容，负权重惩罚错误或风险。核心循环不是直接相信模型写的 rubric，而是先构造 honest answer 和 hack answer，让 adversary 尝试拿高分；如果 exploit 能击败或接近 honest answer，就修复 rubric，使正确、完整的回答重新占优。外层 meta-optimizer 把这些 exploit 汇总成对未来 rubric 写法的改进。与普通 proposer-solver RSI 相比，RRI 的新增点是奖励也在递归改进，而不是只改任务或 solver。
summary.experiments: 论文报告，朴素模型生成的 question-rubric pair 近 99% 被判为 hackable，说明开放式自生成奖励的默认质量很差。HealthBench Professional 上，在零训练数据条件下，RRI-9B 和 RRI-27B 相比 Generation Only 自改进基线的 adjusted score 分别提高 10.9 和 12.4 分；当冻结 9B 模型承担所有辅助角色时，仍提高 10.3 分。在已有 task/reward co-evolution 的循环中加入 adversary，9B 设置下额外提高 2.7 分。域外评测方面，只基于 HealthBench Professional 描述训练的 RRI-27B，在 PRBench Hard 上比 base model 提高 6.6 分，在 ProfBench 上提高 8.0 分；Generation Only 对应提升为 1.2 和 4.7 分。论文还分析了 medical、legal、financial、scientific 任务中的 12,147 个 exploit，将其归入五类 reward failure 和一类 incorrect fix；约三分之一 exploit 是错误内容未被任何准则惩罚，另三分之一来自准则措辞过松导致的解释空间。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 40–60 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对开放式任务自生成 rubric 的失败定义，特别是 99% hackable 的动机实验。Method 部分重点看 Figure 1 的五角色管线、rubric 的带权形式、adversary 如何构造 exploit，以及 meta-optimizer 如何把 exploit 反馈写回 proposer 指令。实验部分优先看 HealthBench Professional 的主表、加入 adversary 的消融、PRBench Hard 和 ProfBench 的域外结果。分析部分的 12,147 个 exploit 分类值得读，它比单个分数更能说明 reward 失败来自哪里。读的时候要保留一个判断：RRI 改善了 rubric 的抗利用性，但它仍依赖模型自身生成 honest answer、hack 和修复方案，因此不能替代外部事实校验或专家审查。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies self-generated rewards for open-ended expert tasks. In math and coding, self-improvement loops can check final answers through execution, unit tests, or answer keys. Clinical reports, legal analysis, and financial advice do not have such checks. A model can generate both a task and a rubric, but naive rubrics are often incomplete or ambiguous, allowing a solver to mention expected topics while omitting the underlying facts or making unpenalized errors.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to post-training and recursive data generation than to base pretraining, but it is relevant to any training loop that relies on model-generated supervision. The key idea is to use reward hacking as supervision before the solver trains: attack each generated rubric, repair it, and only then use it for learning. This matters for RL pretraining, continual self-training, and synthetic instruction pipelines because the limiting factor is often not producing tasks, but producing rewards that models cannot easily exploit. The approach improves robustness of generated rubrics, while still depending on the model’s own ability to produce honest answers, hacks, and fixes.
summary_en.technical_approach: RRI has five components. A proposer writes tasks and weighted rubrics. An adversary tries to exploit each rubric. A judge scores answers according to the rubric. A solver is trained from the resulting rewards. A meta-optimizer reads training feedback and confirmed exploits, then rewrites the proposer’s instructions for future task and rubric generation. Each task consists of a request x and a rubric R={(c_j,p_j)}, where c_j is a criterion and p_j is a nonzero weight in [-10,10]. Positive criteria reward required content; negative criteria penalize mistakes or unsafe behavior. Instead of trusting the generated rubric, RRI first compares an honest answer against adversarial answers designed to game the rubric. If the exploit can score too well, the rubric is repaired so that the honest answer wins. The outer loop accumulates these failures into better meta-prompts for future rubrics. The main difference from standard proposer-solver RSI is that the reward itself is recursively improved, not only the task distribution or the solver.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that nearly 99% of naively generated question-rubric pairs are classified as hackable, indicating that default model-written rewards are weak. On HealthBench Professional with zero training data, RRI-9B and RRI-27B improve adjusted score over the Generation Only self-improvement baseline by 10.9 and 12.4 points. When a frozen 9B model fills every auxiliary role, the gain is still 10.3 points. Adding the adversary to a loop that already co-evolves tasks and rewards adds 2.7 points in the 9B setting. For out-of-domain evaluation, RRI-27B trained only from the HealthBench Professional description improves over the base model by 6.6 points on PRBench Hard and 8.0 points on ProfBench, while Generation Only gains 1.2 and 4.7 points. The analysis covers 12,147 exploits across medical, legal, financial, and scientific tasks, grouped into five reward-failure categories plus incorrect fixes. About one third of the exploits contain wrong content that no criterion penalizes, and another third rely on loosely worded criteria.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 40–60 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the introduction’s framing of open-ended rubric failure and the motivation experiment showing that most naive rubrics are hackable. In the method section, focus on Figure 1, the weighted rubric format, the adversary’s exploit generation, and the meta-optimizer’s prompt update mechanism. In the experiments, prioritize the main HealthBench Professional results, the adversary ablation, and the PRBench Hard and ProfBench transfer results. The exploit taxonomy is worth reading because it explains the failure modes behind the aggregate scores. The main limitation to track is that RRI improves resistance to rubric gaming, but it does not provide an external source of factual truth or expert validation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“训练信号也会被模型反向优化”讲得很具体；若你在看 RL 反哺 pretrain，只读 adversary 如何暴露 rubric 漏洞那部分就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes the failure mode of model-optimized training signals concrete; if you care about RL feeding back into pretraining, read the adversary-for-rubric part and skip the rest.

paper.title: Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems
paper.abstract: Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 自我改进中编辑探索和完整验证之间的预算冲突：窄搜索会漏掉有效改进，逐个完整评估又会过早耗尽预算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 改进范式和搜索方法。它把 speculative decoding 的思想迁移到 agent 版本搜索：先草拟可执行后继 agent，但必须完整验证后才采纳；对长期 agent 优化和 evaluator 固定的训练闭环有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement。SpecRSI 在前驱 agent 未完成评估时就草拟后继 agent，用 Verification-Aware Tree Search 在继续编辑和等待验证之间分配预算，并用 Group Verification Optimization 从已完成搜索中训练 improver，同时保持真实 evaluator 固定。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出主要结果：在科学任务比较中，terminal gains 相比 Janus 高 33.3%–40.0%；在 50 个 scientific backbone-task pairs 上均超过 Janus；相比 MetaRSI-v1 高 1.85%–2.3%。摘要未给出具体模型、任务定义和验证成本细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the budget tradeoff in recursive agent improvement: narrow search misses useful edit chains, while fully evaluating every intermediate agent consumes the budget too early.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent self-improvement and search contribution. It adapts the idea of speculative drafting from tokens to executable agent successors, with full verification required before adoption.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecRSI drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated. Verification-Aware Tree Search allocates budget between further edits and pending checks using predicted verified continuation return. Group Verification Optimization trains the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 33.3%–40.0% higher terminal gains than Janus in the main scientific comparison, improvements over Janus on all 50 scientific backbone-task pairs, and 1.85%–2.3% gains over MetaRSI-v1. Model sizes, task details, and verification costs are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只读 VATS 的预算分配和失败案例；agent RSI 容易被 evaluator 污染，固定真实评估器是这里较干净的点。
recommendation.en: Skim VATS and failure cases; agent RSI is prone to evaluator leakage, and the fixed real evaluator is the clean part here.

paper.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges,

summary.core_problem: 解决 scientific agent swarm 在递归自我改进中难以判断失败来自 hypothesis 还是 implementation，以及整体分数掩盖可复用局部组件的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 系统框架创新。它关注 AI scientist 场景中的自我改进循环、实验反馈利用和多 agent 组件复用；对自动化研究系统有参考意义，但离 LLM 基座预训练方法仍较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SwarmRSI。框架包含 Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation，用其他 agent 的实验反馈来修正 hypothesis 和 implementation；Complementary Swarm Recombination 则保留部分有效 hypothesis 和 program components，并在不同 agent 间重组；Recursive Swarm Evolution 把 mutation 与 recombination 放入持续反馈循环，让局部成功结果支持新的研究尝试。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法用于 evolving scientific agent swarms，并强调能利用失败实验和部分结果。未给出具体科学任务集合、agent 数量、LLM backbone、实验轮数、baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets recursive self-improvement for scientific agent swarms, where failed experiments make it hard to tell whether the hypothesis or implementation should be revised and where aggregate scores hide reusable partial components.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system framework. It focuses on self-improvement loops, use of experimental feedback, and component reuse in AI-scientist-style systems. It is relevant to automated research workflows, but only indirectly connected to LLM base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SwarmRSI introduces Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation, which uses experimental feedback from other agents to refine hypotheses and implementations. It also introduces Complementary Swarm Recombination, which reuses retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop for continued swarm improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the framework evolves scientific agent swarms and uses failed or partial experimental results. It does not provide the task suite, number of agents, LLM backbone, number of evolution rounds, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 概念方向可备案，但摘要缺少硬实验；对预训练研究员而言，看 mutation/recombination 定义即可。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a concept note, but the abstract lacks hard experiments; for pretraining researchers, only the mutation/recombination definitions are worth a look.

paper.title: AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents wi

summary.core_problem: 解决递归自我改进（RSI）型研究代理在长期目标下如何随计算扩展而稳定协作、共享知识并持续改进的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 agent 系统方向的工作，贡献主要是多代理组织与资源分配框架，而不是 LLM 基座训练本身。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它把“更多 agent 不一定更好”具体化为评估偏差、知识共享失真和程序迁移失败三个系统瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AReaL-RSI 框架，不更新 backbone LLM 权重，而是在 persistent research team 上做外部递归改进。核心包括：leader agent 选择研究方向并协调任务；conditional memory sharing 区分未解决问题与已支持结论，并让接收方按上下文适配；每轮 campaign 后进行 evidence-based review，更新研究者的方向、知识和技能，用系统级资源消耗与结果质量共同定义扩展效果。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据或 backbone 细节。实验重点应是长期研究任务上的系统扩展性、协作收益和资源效率，而非标准 LLM benchmark。由于没有权重更新，结果更像 agent orchestration ablation，而不是可迁移到预训练 recipe 的 clean evidence。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how recursive self-improvement agents can scale coordination, memory sharing, and persistent progress under long-horizon objectives without updating backbone LLM weights.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a general agent-systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value to pretraining researchers is indirect: it makes concrete why simply adding more agents can fail, due to misleading early evaluations, loss of applicability conditions in shared findings, and poor transfer of useful procedures.
summary_en.technical_approach: AReaL-RSI organizes a persistent team of research agents. A leader agent selects research orientations and coordinates ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing separates unresolved problems from supported findings and lets recipients adapt them to local context; after each campaign, an evidence-based review updates agent orientation, knowledge, and skills. Scaling is framed jointly in terms of outcome quality and total system resource expenditure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or backbone details. The empirical focus appears to be long-horizon research tasks, coordination gains, and system-level efficiency rather than standard LLM benchmarks. Since no backbone weights are updated, the evidence is more about agent orchestration than transferable pretraining methodology.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent 组织学，不是 pretrain 论文；若你在看 test-time scaling 或 self-improvement，只需抓它对“共享记忆会失真”的建模，正文不必深读。
recommendation.en: This is agent organization, not pretraining; if you care about test-time scaling or self-improvement, only extract its treatment of memory-sharing distortion and skip the rest.

paper.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
paper.abstract: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains h

summary.core_problem: 解决开放世界任务中，LLM agent 的执行 harness 如何在没有可靠 verifier 的情况下在线自我改进，并把经验迁移到新任务的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 agent 系统方法论文，贡献点不在基座模型本身，而在把 recursive self-improvement 从封闭任务推进到开放任务。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提供了一个观察“外部脚手架能替代多少模型能力”的实验框架，也涉及无真值反馈下的训练信号设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Harness^2，两层递归。第一层 task-level recursion 用 contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose 机制对当前任务的 harness 做编辑，通过对比式探测而不是 ground-truth verifier 来筛选改动；并支持并行或串行递归扩展。第二层 harnessing-level recursion 从多个任务上的编辑经验中抽取可迁移模式，形成对新任务可复用的 harness 改进策略。整体是 plug-and-play 的 agent harness 框架，而不是改底座模型参数。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出明确模型规模、数据规模和完整基线细节。可确认的是，实验面向 open-world、test-time novel tasks，比较对象应包括非递归 harness、仅 task-specific RSI 或常规 agent harness。论文声称在无 verifier 条件下仍能稳定改进当前任务表现，并把改进泛化到新场景，但需要看正文中的任务集构成、ablation 和失败案例来判断结论是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to improve an LLM agent’s execution harness online in open-world tasks without reliable verifiers, while transferring the learned harnessing experience to novel tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-systems paper rather than a foundation-model paper. Its value to pretraining researchers is indirect: it probes how much capability can be shifted from the base model into the external harness, and how to construct learning signals when no ground-truth verifier is available.
summary_en.technical_approach: Harness^2 introduces two levels of recursion. At the task level, it refines the current harness with a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose procedure, using comparative probing instead of ground-truth verification to guide edits; recursion can be parallelized or applied sequentially. At the harnessing level, it extracts reusable patterns from prior harness edits across tasks, so the system can generalize harness improvements to unseen scenarios. The method edits the agent scaffold rather than the model weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, data scale, or full baseline details. What is clear is that the evaluation targets open-world tasks that are novel at test time, likely against non-recursive harnesses and task-specific RSI variants. The claimed result is that the method improves task performance without verifiers and transfers gains to new scenarios, but the credibility will depend on the task distribution, ablations, and failure analysis in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，更多是在测 harness 能替代多少模型能力；只建议看方法图和泛化实验，别把它误读成模型自改进结论。
recommendation.en: Only loosely relevant to pretraining; it is really about how much capability can be offloaded to the harness. Read the method figure and transfer experiments, but do not over-interpret it as model self-improvement.

paper.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates b

summary.core_problem: 在“不可验证/难评估”的开放式任务上做递归自我改进（RSI）时，如何绕开监督瓶颈并避免单模型自评自训的同质化闭环失效。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法/系统范式：把“多智能体拓扑/工作流”当作可搜索的计算图，并用自生成轨迹做迭代式自监督微调；对理解 post-train 如何反哺 pretrain（通过更强的自生成训练信号与更稳的自评机制）有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MASS：用同一个 base LLM 扮演“提出-执行-自评”的多角色，交替进行(1) 进化式搜索：在结构护栏约束下搜索多智能体工作流拓扑（角色划分、信息路由、调用顺序等），以自评/任务信号作为适应度；(2) 用搜索得到的高质量轨迹做 SFT，形成递归改进。核心点是把 multi-agent orchestration 显式参数化为计算图并进行结构化搜索，而不是固定模板的 self-refine。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量与定量结果细节；可预期对比基线包括单体 self-critique/self-refine、固定多智能体拓扑（如 debate/committee）与无进化搜索的自训练。需要看正文确认：任务集合是否“不可验证”、适应度/自评是否有外部锚点、以及是否存在 reward hacking/过拟合工作流模板。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable recursive self-improvement (RSI) on non-verifiable open-ended tasks without collapsing into a homogeneous self-evaluation loop.
summary_en.importance: Method/system contribution: treats multi-agent topologies/workflows as searchable computation graphs and alternates evolutionary workflow search with SFT on self-generated trajectories; relevant as a post-train signal-design pattern that may feed back into pretraining via better synthetic supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: MASS alternates (1) evolutionary search over structured multi-agent workflow graphs under guardrails (roles, routing, ordering) using self-evaluation/fitness signals, and (2) supervised fine-tuning on the discovered high-quality trajectories. Key idea is explicit parameterization and optimization of orchestration graphs rather than fixed self-refinement templates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, data scale, or quantitative deltas. Likely baselines include single-model self-critique, fixed multi-agent topologies, and self-training without evolutionary search. The main thing to verify in the paper is whether the evaluation/fitness has any external anchors and how robust it is to reward hacking.

recommendation.zh: 把“多智能体拓扑”当可优化对象这点值得看，但自评适应度若缺外部锚点很容易自嗨；建议只读工作流参数化与护栏设计那几节。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for treating multi-agent topology as an optimizable object, but self-eval fitness without external anchors is prone to self-delusion; focus on workflow parameterization and guardrail design.

paper.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks g

summary.core_problem: 递归自我改进依赖外部反馈成本高，而 world model 又会随着 policy 演化而失真；这篇工作要解决的是如何用可适配的 world model 支撑跨版本的持续改进。
summary.importance: 它不是 pretrain 论文，但和 pretrain↔post-train 闭环有一定关系，尤其是“模型更新后训练信号是否失配”“如何选择更有价值的学习数据”这两个问题。贡献类型偏通用 agent 框架与持续改进机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RSI-Anything，建立在 JEPA-Anything 之上，用预测式 world model 指导动作选择和学习数据选择。框架里有三层机制：观测反馈用于 policy 或 workflow 改进；条件式 world-model adaptation 用于跟上新 policy 分布；组件与兼容性检查决定是否保留更新后的 policy-model 对。核心思想是把 world model 从静态 verifier 升级为可随策略共同演化的选择器与评估器。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出几个代表性结果：代码修复中，在 coder 固定时，成功率从静态 verifier 的 26.3% 提升到 predictive selection 的 29.2%，再到 world-model adaptation 后的 31.2%，测试使用量相近；GUI 任务完成率更高且平均动作数下降 39.4%；跨五个连续 policy 版本，后期版本仍保持收益。实验说明它至少在持续改进设定下有增益，但还需核查 world model 误导、分布漂移和 compatibility check 的失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: Recursive self-improvement is limited by costly external feedback, while world-model predictions become unreliable as policies evolve. This work studies how to use an adaptive world model to support persistent improvement across policy versions.
summary_en.importance: It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train loop, especially around signal mismatch after model updates and the selection of more valuable learning data. The contribution is mainly a general agent framework for continual self-improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes RSI-Anything, built on JEPA-Anything, using a predictive world model to guide both action selection and learning-data selection. The framework combines observed feedback for policy/workflow improvement, conditional world-model adaptation to track policy shifts, and component/compatibility checks to decide whether updated policy-model pairs should be retained. The key idea is to turn the world model from a static verifier into a co-evolving selector and evaluator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports code-repair gains from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% with predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. GUI evaluations show higher completion with 39.4% fewer actions. Gains also persist across five successive policy versions. This suggests value in continual-improvement settings, though the main thing to inspect is failure under distribution shift and whether compatibility checks are doing most of the work.

recommendation.zh: 想看的是“world model 会不会随 policy 漂移而失效”这个点，不是 RSI 口号；先看 code repair 那组 ablation，若 adaptation 真比静态 verifier 稳，就能借鉴到 self-play/RL 数据选择里。
recommendation.en: The interesting part is not the RSI slogan but whether the world model actually degrades as policy shifts; read the code-repair ablation first, and only keep the idea if adaptation clearly beats a static verifier.

paper.title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Environments are the foundation of recursive self-improvement: they provide the problems agents work on and the feedback used to evaluate progress. Yet constructing challenging research environments with reliable evaluation still depends on domain experts, limiting their scale and disciplinary coverage. We introduce RSI-Forge, a multi-agent pipeline that turns published papers into executable environments for self-improvement. Three agents coordinate construction, reproduction, and review to pro

summary.core_problem: 解决 recursive self-improvement 缺少可规模化、可自动评测研究环境的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent/RL 环境与评测资产构建。它把论文转成 executable environments，并带自动 evaluator 与 baseline reimplementation，面向的是能否让 agent 在研究任务上持续改进，而不是单次问答。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RSI-Forge，一个多 agent pipeline：construction agent 从论文抽取任务与环境；reproduction agent 独立复现论文方法并建立 baseline score；review agent 检查任务、评测器和可改进空间。每个环境包含起始解法、自动 evaluator 和可用于后续优化的反馈信号。
summary.experiments: 构建了 210 个环境，覆盖 18 个领域，其中 90 个由独立人类领域专家评审。专家和 agent judge 都认为这些环境具有改进起始解法的空间，evaluator 也能区分解法质量；但专家对 shortcut resistance、对原论文的 faithfulness、以及部分任务设计更挑剔。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of scalable, executable research environments with reliable evaluation for recursive self-improvement.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an agent-evaluation and environment-construction asset. It turns papers into executable tasks with automated evaluators and reproduced baselines, targeting iterative improvement rather than one-shot QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSI-Forge is a multi-agent pipeline with construction, reproduction, and review roles. It extracts tasks from papers, reimplements the paper method to establish a baseline score, and checks whether the resulting environment provides meaningful feedback for further improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The authors produce 210 environments across 18 fields, with 90 reviewed by independent human domain experts. Both experts and agent judges rate the improvement potential and evaluator discrimination positively, while experts are more critical of shortcut resistance, faithfulness to the source paper, and task quality.

recommendation.zh: 读环境生成流程和专家评审表；它像 RLVR 环境工厂，但 shortcut resistance 是主要风险。
recommendation.en: Read the environment pipeline and expert-review tables; it is close to an RLVR environment factory, with shortcut resistance as the main risk.

paper.title: EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation
paper.abstract: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene,

summary.core_problem: 如何在仿真中规模化生成“可训练机器人基础模型”的具身数据，同时让场景生成与任务生成相互对齐、可递归改进。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“数据生成系统/管线”：把资产-场景-任务生成打通，并用递归自改进（RSI）闭环缓解“生成出来的场景不适合任务、生成出来的任务又不落地”的常见断裂；对具身多模态预训练的数据供给有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EmbodiedSmith：统一资产/场景/任务生成；核心是 agentic refinement loop——场景生成阶段显式预判下游任务需求，任务生成阶段反过来驱动对场景做定向编辑，从而迭代提升任务生成成功率与长时序任务可执行性；并宣称支持更复杂 embodiment（移动操作、类人、灵巧手）与物理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键规模细节（数据量、任务集、成功率提升幅度、与哪些生成管线/仿真基线对比、是否训练了 foundation policy/模型并验证迁移）。当前只能确认其在“任务生成成功率/长时序任务”上有提升主张。

summary_en.core_problem: How to scale embodied training data in simulation while aligning scene generation with task generation via a recursive improvement loop.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a data-generation/system contribution: it unifies asset/scene/task generation and uses a recursive self-improvement loop to reduce the common mismatch between generated scenes and executable tasks, which is relevant to embodied multimodal pretraining data supply.
summary_en.technical_approach: EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation. The key is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, and task generation triggers targeted scene edits, iteratively improving task feasibility and long-horizon task generation; it also targets complex embodiments and physics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks critical scale and cleanliness details (data volume, task suites, exact gains, baselines, and whether a foundation model/policy is trained and evaluated for transfer). Claims focus on improved task-generation success, including long-horizon tasks.

recommendation.zh: 把“场景-任务”生成做成闭环这点比常见资产堆砌更像样，但缺少训练/迁移闭环与规模细节；当作具身数据管线思路备查即可。
recommendation.en: The scene–task co-refinement loop is more principled than asset dumping, but without scale/transfer and training-loop evidence it’s a weak signal—keep it as a pipeline idea reference.

paper.title: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Iterative self-distillation enables LLM agents to learn from successive deployments, offering a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet our experiments with existing methods reveal a collapse in deployment performance across cycles, while task performance with privileged information (PI) also declines. We address this collapse by prioritizing informative interaction steps for distillation and preserving PI-conditioned behavior as the student becomes the next teacher. We introduce Reten

summary.core_problem: 在基于特权信息（Privileged Information, PI）的迭代式智能体自蒸馏中，模型性能在多轮部署循环后会出现崩溃（collapse），且在带有特权信息条件下的任务性能也会下降。
summary.importance: 揭示了迭代自蒸馏（如 OEL、SDPO）中存在的性能崩溃问题，并提出了一种即插即用的增强方法，对探索 LLM 智能体的递归自我改进（RSI）具有启发意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReSAIL 方法，包含两个模块：1) 轨迹平衡选择性蒸馏（TBSD）：通过计算教师模型在有无 PI 时的输出分布差异（PI 敏感度），优先选择 PI 影响最大的交互步骤进行蒸馏，并在轨迹间平衡损失。2) 特权保留（PR）：在所有步骤上，通过正则化将更新后学生模型在特权视图下的输出分布拉向冻结的教师模型，以保留其在下一轮作为教师时的 PI 条件行为能力。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld 和 TextCraft 上进行了三轮部署循环实验。结果显示，ReSAIL 显著缓解了性能崩溃，最终轮成功率平均比 SDPO 和 OEL 基线高出 22.5 个百分点。在 AITZ 多模态 GUI 智能体任务上，敏感度引导的选择也提升了动作预测准确率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 3 了解 TBSD 和 PR 的具体机制，特别是 PI 敏感度的定义（Equation 3）。Section 4 的实验结果（Figure 1 和 Figure 3）直观展示了性能崩溃现象及 ReSAIL 的缓解效果。

summary_en.core_problem: In iterative agent self-distillation based on privileged information (PI), model performance collapses across successive deployment cycles, and task performance conditioned on PI also declines.
summary_en.importance: Identifies the performance collapse issue in iterative self-distillation (e.g., OEL, SDPO) and proposes a plug-in augmentation, offering insights for exploring recursive self-improvement (RSI) in LLM agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ReSAIL, comprising two modules: 1) Trajectory-Balanced Selective Distillation (TBSD): Prioritizes interaction steps for distillation based on PI sensitivity (the divergence between the teacher's output distributions with and without PI) and balances losses across trajectories. 2) Privileged Retention (PR): Regularizes the updated student's privileged-view output distributions toward the frozen teacher's across all steps to preserve its PI-conditioned behavior for the next cycle.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted three deployment cycles on ALFWorld and TextCraft. ReSAIL significantly mitigated performance collapse, improving final-cycle success rates by an average of 22.5 percentage points over SDPO and OEL baselines. Sensitivity-Guided Selection also improved action prediction accuracy for multimodal GUI agents on AITZ.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the mechanisms of TBSD and PR, especially the definition of PI sensitivity (Equation 3). Section 4's experimental results (Figure 1 and Figure 3) clearly illustrate the collapse phenomenon and ReSAIL's mitigation.

recommendation.zh: 关注迭代蒸馏中的性能崩溃现象，其提出的基于特权信息的正则化思路对设计Self-Play或RLHF的迭代策略有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Focuses on performance collapse in iterative distillation; the proposed PI-based regularization offers insights for designing iterative strategies in Self-Play or RLHF.

paper.title: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploratio

summary.core_problem: Gödel Forest 解决的是 data-centric recursive self-improvement 中的搜索组织问题：候选数据策略需要经过训练和评测才能验证，成本很高；单 agent 容易沿着窄方向反复试错，简单并行 agent 又缺少长期搜索深度和有效经验共享。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更接近 post-train / 数据合成自动化，而不是基座预训练方法。它对预训练研究的启发在于：当数据配方、合成策略或训练 recipe 的验证成本很高时，搜索过程本身需要被结构化管理。Gödel Forest 的价值不在某个具体数据生成技巧，而在训练闭环中的探索策略：如何在有限训练预算下同时保留长程假设追踪和多方向探索。这个问题同样存在于 continual pretrain、annealing 数据配比、代码/数学合成数据筛选等场景。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 data-centric RSI 组织成多个共同演化的搜索树。每个 agent 维护自己的私有搜索树，持续提出数据和训练策略，训练从固定初始参数出发的目标模型，再用下游评测反馈来决定深化、回退或改写策略。这保证了单个方向上的长期上下文不会被频繁打断。多个 agent 并行探索不同的数据策略区域，用于增加搜索宽度。它们之间不是直接共享完整执行轨迹，而是通过一个动态 shared evolution memory 异步通信。通信协议可概括为 read-evolve-publish：agent 读取共享记忆中的经验，结合自己的树状态继续演化，再把成功经验、失败模式和诊断结论压缩成可操作的数据 lesson 发布回共享记忆，并用全局 leaderboard 作为锚点。这样做的目的，是避免原始轨迹共享带来的上下文膨胀，同时让失败和成功都能影响其他搜索树。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 RSIBench-Data，覆盖六类任务：SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0、GPQA Diamond 和 AIME 2026。论文报告 Gödel Forest 相比单 agent baseline 平均提升 10.70%。其中 SWE-bench Verified 从 35.00% 提升到 54.00%。端到端 wall-clock 时间在六个 benchmark 中有五个下降。消融显示，共享演化记忆相比独立并行 agent 额外带来 +7.00% 增益，说明收益不是简单来自并行计算，而是来自压缩后的经验共享和搜索方向迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 data-centric RSI 的定义，以及训练闭环为什么让搜索成本变高。方法部分重点看 persistent search tree、budget-aware diagnostic gating、shared evolution memory 和 read-evolve-publish 协议。实验部分优先看单 agent、独立并行 agent、共享记忆多 agent 的消融对比。若只关心预训练数据研究，可以跳过具体 SWE/Terminal 任务细节，把注意力放在数据策略如何被提出、验证、压缩和迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: Gödel Forest studies search organization for data-centric recursive self-improvement. In this setting, an agent proposes data and training strategies, trains candidate models, and uses evaluation feedback to improve future proposals. The bottleneck is that every hypothesis is expensive to validate. A single agent tends to over-exploit narrow directions, while naive parallel agents lose long-horizon depth or communicate through bulky traces.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to post-training and automated data generation than to base-model pretraining. Its relevance to pretraining is the training-in-the-loop search problem. When data mixtures, synthetic data policies, filtering rules, or finetuning recipes are costly to test, the search process needs memory, branching, and coordination. The paper’s main lesson is not a particular data recipe, but a way to balance deep hypothesis refinement with broad exploration under limited training budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gödel Forest represents recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. Each agent maintains a private persistent tree, proposes data or training strategies, trains target models from fixed initial weights, evaluates them, and then deepens, revises, or backtracks based on feedback. This preserves long-horizon context within each direction. Breadth comes from running multiple trees over different regions of the data-strategy space. Coordination is handled through a shared evolution memory rather than raw trace exchange. Agents follow a read-evolve-publish protocol: they read compact lessons from the shared memory, continue local search, and publish distilled successes, failures, and diagnostic rules anchored to a global leaderboard. The design avoids saturating context with full traces while still allowing useful discoveries and dead ends to influence other agents.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses RSIBench-Data across six benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-bench Pro, Terminal-Bench 2.0, GPQA Diamond, and AIME 2026. Gödel Forest improves over the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70%. On SWE-bench Verified, performance rises from 35.00% to 54.00%. End-to-end wall-clock time decreases on five of the six benchmarks. An ablation shows that shared evolution memory gives a +7.00% gain over independent parallel agents, indicating that the gains are not only due to parallelism but also to compact cross-agent transfer of empirical lessons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the definition of data-centric RSI and the cost structure of training-in-the-loop validation. In the method section, focus on persistent search trees, budget-aware diagnostic gating, shared evolution memory, and the read-evolve-publish protocol. In the experiments, prioritize the comparison between single-agent, independent parallel, and shared-memory multi-agent variants. If the interest is pretraining data research, skip most task-specific details and focus on how strategies are proposed, validated, compressed, and reused.

recommendation.zh: 关注其多智能体树搜索机制在数据合成中的应用，对设计 RLHF 或自我对弈的数据生成 pipeline 有启发，重点看其树结构的更新逻辑。
recommendation.en: Focus on its multi-agent tree search mechanism for data synthesis; offers insights for designing RLHF or self-play data generation pipelines, especially the tree update logic.

paper.title: Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding
paper.abstract: An auditor who checks whether a system's weights are frozen is checking the wrong thing. Our stationarity dichotomy says that iterative self-modification hits strict diminishing returns whenever the agent's reachable set of edits stays fixed, and can escape only if that set expands. Rewriting scaffolding (tools, verifiers, decomposition) expands what an agent reaches without touching a weight, so frozen weights buy an eventual ceiling but no stationarity along the way. The criterion also separat

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic coding 中“冻结权重是否足以限制递归自我改进”这一判断标准失真的问题。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但它对 post-train 与 scaffold 设计的边界给出一个清晰框架：性能上限是否变化，取决于可达编辑集合是否扩张，而不只是 checkpoint 是否冻结。贡献更像理论化的系统分析与概念澄清。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 stationarity dichotomy：若 agent 可达的编辑集合固定，迭代自修改会出现严格边际递减；只有当可达集合扩张时，系统才能逃离该上限。基于此区分三类常被混在一起的机制：固定类内搜索、会抬高上限的 test-time training、以及介于两者之间的 scaffold rewriting（工具、验证器、分解方式的改写）。论文还分析 best-of-k 编排与重复咨询固定 worker 池的收益边界。
summary.experiments: 摘要更像理论/概念论文，没有给出标准化 benchmark、模型规模或量化结果。核心输出是若干关于 ceiling、rate、budget 与 horizon 的命题，而非大规模实证。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mistaken assumption that freezing model weights is enough to bound recursive self-improvement in agentic coding systems.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it gives a clean conceptual frame for the boundary between post-training capability and scaffold design: what matters is whether the reachable edit set expands, not whether the checkpoint is frozen. The contribution is mainly theoretical and systems-analytic.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a stationarity dichotomy: if the agent's reachable set of edits stays fixed, iterative self-modification faces strict diminishing returns; it can escape only when that reachable set expands. This separates three regimes often conflated: search within a fixed class, test-time training that raises the ceiling itself, and scaffold rewriting in between. It also analyzes best-of-k orchestration and repeated consultation of a fixed worker pool.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reads as a theory/concept paper and does not report standard benchmarks, model scales, or quantitative gains. The main outputs are claims about ceilings, rates, budgets, and horizons rather than large-scale empirical results.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不教你怎么提分，但会纠正一个常见误判：冻结 checkpoint 不等于能力静止；只读 stationarity dichotomy 和 best-of-k 那段就够。
recommendation.en: It will not tell you how to gain points, but it fixes a common mistake: frozen weights do not imply stationary capability; read it for the stationarity dichotomy and the best-of-k ceiling claim.

paper.title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
paper.abstract: AI agents are beginning to automate research and development across the AI stack, from improving training efficiency to optimizing inference. A natural next step is to improve the research efficiency of the agents themselves. When an AI research agent's own code is the object of optimization, each accepted rewrite becomes the agent that the next round edits. We refer to this loop as recursive self-improvement. Its significance lies in a long-standing trend, in which increased cumulative spending

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能够自我优化其底层代码（Harness layer）的 AI 研究智能体，从而在固定的评估预算下持续提升其自身的研发效率？
summary.importance: 展示了 AI 智能体在代码层面进行递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）的可行性。通过优化控制搜索、上下文和验证的“Harness layer”，智能体不仅能在特定任务上提升性能，还能泛化到未见过的基准测试，并意外降低了奖励作弊（Reward hacking）的比例，为突破 AI 研发的边际收益递减提供了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AIDE^2，一个双循环（Two-loop）双层优化系统。内循环（Inner loop）中，研究智能体针对特定 AI 研发任务优化代码以提升目标指标；外循环（Outer loop）则在元层面（Meta-level）重写内循环智能体的代码，旨在提升其优化能力（即研发效率）。整个过程被结构化为嵌套的树搜索（Nested tree search）。每次接受的代码重写都会成为下一轮迭代的基础。评估时，使用包含三种 AI 研发任务的保留数据集（Held-out data）来验证改进的有效性。
summary.experiments: 在一个为期 8 天的自主运行中，AIDE^2 发现了 7 次连续的改进。最强的发现智能体在 4 个未参与训练的外部基准测试上，达到或超过了经过两年人工研发的强基线模型（AIDE_human）。在保留任务上，奖励作弊率从 55% 降至 32%（低于人工基线的 39%）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Method 部分关于双层优化（Bi-level optimization）和嵌套树搜索的设计。仔细分析实验结果中智能体在未见基准上的泛化能力以及奖励作弊率的下降，思考其背后的机制。这篇论文对理解 Agent 架构设计和自我进化极具启发。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build an AI research agent capable of optimizing its own underlying code (the harness layer) to continuously improve its research efficiency under a fixed evaluation budget?
summary_en.importance: It demonstrates the feasibility of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the code level for AI agents. By optimizing the 'harness layer' that controls search, context, and verification, the agent not only improves performance on specific tasks but also generalizes to unseen benchmarks and unexpectedly reduces reward hacking, offering a new path to counter diminishing returns in AI R&D.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper presents AIDE^2, a two-loop, bi-level optimization system. In the inner loop, a research agent optimizes code for specific AI R&D tasks against a measurable metric. The outer loop operates at a meta-level, rewriting the inner-loop agent's code to improve its optimization capability (i.e., research efficiency). The entire process is structured as a nested tree search. Each accepted rewrite becomes the agent for the next iteration. Improvements are validated using held-out data spanning three families of AI R&D tasks.
summary_en.experiments: In an autonomous 8-day run, AIDE^2 discovered seven successive improvements. The strongest discovered agent matched or exceeded a strong human-engineered baseline (AIDE_human, developed over two years) on four external benchmarks not used during the run. On a held-out task family, the reward hacking rate dropped from 55% to 32% (below the baseline's 39%).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section detailing the bi-level optimization and nested tree search design. Carefully analyze the experimental results regarding generalization to unseen benchmarks and the reduction in reward hacking, and consider the underlying mechanisms. This paper is highly inspiring for understanding agent architecture design and self-evolution.

recommendation.zh: 极具前瞻性的工作，真正在 code level 跑通了 Agent 的 recursive self-improvement 闭环，其发现的改进策略（如搜索策略、内存机制）对设计更强的 coding agent 极具参考价值。
recommendation.en: A highly forward-looking work that successfully executes a recursive self-improvement loop for Agents at the code level; the discovered improvements (e.g., search policies, memory mechanisms) are highly valuable for designing stronger coding agents.

paper.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
paper.abstract: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-d

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的问题是：自动化 agent harness 迭代优化会在有限 evolve set 上产生自适应过拟合，导致训练集式收益很高，但迁移到未见任务、工具接口或 verifier 时收益缩小甚至消失。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对 agent 系统的 post-train、自动提示/脚手架优化和评测隔离有实际参考。它把 agent 能力提升拆成两部分：冻结模型权重和可编辑 harness。很多系统收益来自 prompts、控制流、工具描述、记忆和上下文管理，而这些组件一旦通过同一批任务反复搜索，就会像模型训练一样过拟合。对预训练研究员的启发是：只要存在反馈驱动的迭代优化，就需要把优化集、选择准则、复杂度控制和迁移评估一起设计，而不能只看 evolve-set 分数。
summary.technical_approach: RRSI 将 harness evolution 形式化为固定 backbone policy π、优化外部 harness H。H 包括系统提示、任务提示、控制流、工具接口、记忆文件和上下文管理。普通 RSI 循环是在第 t 轮用当前 harness 跑 evolve set，收集轨迹和反馈，让 proposer LLM 生成候选 harness，再在同一个 evolve set 上选择得分最高者。作者指出这里有三类过拟合来源：编码 benchmark-specific patterns、追逐 evaluator noise、不断积累无助于迁移的复杂度。RRSI 不限制哪些 harness 组件可改，而是在 proposal 和 selection 两端加正则。proposal 侧鼓励更简单、可复用的修改，避免把候选改成 evolve set 的特例补丁；selection 侧使用更稳健的保留标准，减少由噪声、任务特定线索或额外复杂度带来的虚假提升。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个领域、8 个 benchmark。每个领域中，harness 只在一个 suite 上演化，然后不再修改，直接迁移到 held-out benchmarks。RRSI 在 evolve split 上最高提升 14.1 分，在全部 6 个 held-out splits 上都有提升，OOD 最高提升 4.7 分。同时，它使用的 policy tokens 少于未正则化的 evolution。论文还报告 RRSI 在 held-out environments 上相对 prior baselines 的平均优势最高达到 22.9%。这些结果支持两个结论：正则化没有完全牺牲 evolve-set 收益；更重要的是，它减少了 harness 搜索对特定评测集的适配。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，重点理解 evolve-to-transfer gap，而不是只看 evolve split 的提升。Preliminaries 值得读，因为它清楚区分了 backbone policy、harness、trajectory、verifier 和 policy-token cost。方法部分重点看 Figure 2，以及 proposal regularization 和 selection regularization 各自约束什么信号。实验部分建议优先看 held-out benchmarks、token cost、以及和 unregularized evolution 的对比；如果时间有限，消融实验比主表更能说明哪些正则项真正抑制了过拟合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses adaptive overfitting in automated agent-harness evolution: iterative prompt, control-flow, tool, memory, and context edits can improve performance on a finite evolve set without transferring to unseen tasks or environments.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to agent post-training and system optimization than to base-model pretraining. Its main value is the framing of harness improvement as an optimization process with the same generalization risks as model training. When a frozen model is repeatedly tuned through feedback on a small set of tasks, benchmark-specific patches, evaluator noise, and unnecessary complexity can all create misleading gains. This is useful for researchers designing SFT/RL data loops, agent evaluation protocols, or automated scaffold search.
summary_en.technical_approach: RRSI treats the backbone policy as fixed and optimizes the harness around it. The harness includes system and task prompts, control flow, tool interfaces and descriptions, memory or skill files, and context-management rules. A standard recursive self-improvement loop runs the current harness on an evolve set, summarizes trajectories into feedback, asks an LLM proposer to generate candidate harnesses, evaluates those candidates on the same evolve set, and selects the best one. The paper regularizes both sides of this loop. On the proposal side, it favors simpler and more reusable edits instead of benchmark-specific patches. On the selection side, it applies more robust criteria so that candidates are less likely to be retained because of evaluation noise, task-specific cues, or accumulated complexity. The design keeps all harness components editable, but constrains how finite feedback drives the search.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans eight benchmarks across three domains. In each domain, the harness is evolved on one suite and then run unchanged on held-out benchmarks. RRSI improves the evolving split by up to 14.1 points and improves all six held-out splits, with out-of-distribution gains up to 4.7 points. It also uses fewer policy tokens than unregularized evolution. The paper reports up to a 22.9% average advantage over prior baselines on held-out environments. The key empirical result is not only the in-domain gain, but the reduction of the evolve-to-transfer gap.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand the adaptive overfitting problem and the evolve-to-transfer gap. Read the preliminaries carefully enough to track the distinction between policy, harness, trajectory, verifier, and token cost. In the method section, focus on Figure 2 and the two regularization points: candidate proposal and candidate selection. In the experiments, prioritize held-out benchmark results, policy-token cost, and comparisons with unregularized evolution. The ablations are the most useful part if the goal is to understand which constraints actually improve transfer.

recommendation.zh: 将正则化思想引入智能体脚手架的自我进化中，缓解了过拟合问题，对设计更鲁棒的 Agent 框架有启发，重点看正则化策略的设计。
recommendation.en: Introduces regularization into the self-evolution of agent harnesses to mitigate overfitting, inspiring the design of more robust Agent frameworks; focus on the design of regularization strategies.

paper.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
paper.abstract: Recursive self-improvement is becoming increasingly vital for autonomous AI agents, where progress hinges on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. The driver of this process is effective exploration, however, managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck.
