summary.core_problem: 如何解决自主 AI Agent 在复杂领域中探索策略难以扩展和优化的瓶颈？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于“重放模拟器”中“做梦（dreaming）”的递归自我改进框架，实现了探索策略的可扩展和自我优化。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 Dream-RSI 框架。核心思想是将累积的发现历史作为已实现搜索空间的重放模拟器。通过在由历史发现树构建的重放模拟器中执行“做梦”，Agent 可以在不进行昂贵的环境交互的情况下，优化其探索策略（如节点选择和扩展）。
summary.experiments: 在相关复杂领域（如代码生成或定理证明，具体需看正文）验证了 Dream-RSI 能够有效提升 Agent 的探索效率和最终性能。

summary_en.core_problem: How to overcome the bottleneck of scaling and optimizing exploration strategies for autonomous AI agents in complex domains?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a recursive self-improvement framework based on 'dreaming' in a 'replay simulator', enabling scalable and self-optimizing exploration strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Dream-RSI framework. The core idea is to use the accumulated discovery history as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By performing 'dreaming' in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, the agent can optimize its exploration strategies (e.g., node selection and expansion) without expensive environmental interactions.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in relevant complex domains (e.g., code generation or theorem proving, details in the paper) that Dream-RSI effectively improves the agent's exploration efficiency and final performance.

recommendation.zh: DeepMind 提出的 Agent 探索策略优化框架，利用历史轨迹构建模拟器进行离线策略更新，对 RLHF/RLAIF 中如何高效利用探索数据有启发。
recommendation.en: An agent exploration strategy optimization framework from DeepMind, utilizing historical trajectories to build a simulator for offline policy updates; inspiring for efficient utilization of exploration data in RLHF/RLAIF.

paper.title: DataFoundry: Evolving Data Preparators via Recursive Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Domain adaptation of large language models increasingly depends on constructing high-quality training data, yet existing data-preparation pipelines typically address quality only after generation through post-hoc filtering. This creates a fundamental mismatch: data-quality issues often originate from the construction process itself, while quality control is applied only to its outputs. We introduce \textsc{DataFoundry}, a framework for \textbf{evolving data preparators through recursive self-imp

summary.core_problem: 解决大模型领域适应中，数据准备流水线通常只在生成后进行过滤，导致数据质量问题无法从源头解决的根本错配。
summary.importance: 提出 DataFoundry 框架，通过递归自我改进来进化数据准备器（data preparators），将数据质量控制前置到数据构建过程本身，是一种新颖的数据工程范式。
summary.technical_approach: 将数据准备器表示为可进化的运行时规范，并采用 Skills-as-Modules 架构。中心 Controller 编排模块化技能以编译可执行运行时，在小型试点集上使用领域特定标准诊断缺陷，并将诊断反馈转化为适配器，从而在保留原有功能的同时修正单个准备组件。
summary.experiments: （摘要未提供具体实验数据，需看正文，但方法论具有启发性）

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the fundamental mismatch in LLM domain adaptation where data preparation pipelines typically apply quality control only post-generation, failing to resolve quality issues at their source.
summary_en.importance: Introduces DataFoundry, a framework that evolves data preparators through recursive self-improvement, shifting data quality control upstream to the construction process itself, representing a novel data engineering paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Represents a data preparator as an evolvable runtime specification using a Skills-as-Modules architecture. A central Controller orchestrates modular skills to compile executable runtimes, diagnoses deficiencies on small pilot sets using domain-appropriate criteria, and translates diagnostic feedback into adapters that revise individual preparation components while preserving original functionality.

paper.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses

We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes fail

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 agent 在历史过长时任务状态被淹没、技能调用失配、递归自改进难以稳定闭环的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 架构与系统方法工作，不是预训练论文；价值在于把长期执行拆成工作记忆与经验记忆，并把失败定位和局部更新做成可验证闭环，对研究 post-train 到 agent 接口有一定参考。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets long-horizon agents where growing histories obscure the latent task state, mis-trigger skills, and make recursive self-improvement unstable.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent systems paper rather than a pretraining paper; its value is in decomposing long-horizon execution into working vs experiential memory and turning failures into localized updates, which is mildly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Recuris introduces an explicit Working Memory to track current task progress and an Experiential Memory to store skills and prior experience. Skill selection is grounded in the current working state instead of the full history. Execution traces are converted into structured evidence that localizes failures to memory components, and a fixed Meta-Agent performs validation-gated local updates to Skill Memory, creating a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 4 long-horizon benchmarks with 10 models. The abstract does not specify training scale, extra supervision requirements, or full ablations against stronger memory/tool-use baselines.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory engineering，不改预训练 prior；只看失败定位和 validation-gated 更新设计，若你在做 long-horizon harness 可借鉴，否则读摘要够了。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent-memory engineering, not a pretraining shift; read it for the failure-localization and validation-gated update loop, otherwise the abstract is enough.

summary.core_problem: 如何评估 LLM Agent 设计和改进 AI 训练算法（即递归自我改进 RSI 的核心能力）的能力？
summary.importance: 提出了首个专门隔离并评估 Agent '算法设计'能力的基准测试 AI4AI-Bench，填补了评估 AI 系统能否真正实现递归自我改进（修改自身训练代码）的空白。

summary.experiments: （摘要未提供具体基线模型得分，重点在于基准的设计和流程）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the ability of LLM Agents to design and improve AI training algorithms, which is the core capability for Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI)?
summary_en.importance: Introduces AI4AI-Bench, the first benchmark that isolates and evaluates an agent's 'algorithmic design' capability, filling a gap in assessing whether AI systems can truly achieve RSI by modifying their own training code.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a benchmark of 10 frozen research repositories spanning 10 training algorithm families. recommendation.en: An ambitious benchmark testing if Agents can rewrite DL training code to improve performance (a prototype for RSI); hardcore setup, worth reading for those interested in the AI Scientist direction.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether interactive-agent capability should be improved by co-evolving the model and its runtime harness rather than scaling the model alone.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system architecture and self-improvement workflow. It highlights that the harness controls context, tools, control flow, and stopping behavior, and also shapes the trajectories used for later model updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes HELIX, a source-traceable substrate for harness evolution. Agent systems are decomposed into typed ports, reusable atoms, recipes, product shells, and runtime policies. The loop builds harnesses for a fixed model, updates the model from verified sibling trajectories, and rebuilds harnesses as capabilities change.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is mainly architectural. It does not provide concrete model sizes, task suites, number of improvement rounds, quantitative gains, or comparisons against existing agent frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 概念方向对 agentic post-train 有用，但若没有强实验，只看 harness 分解和 provenance 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Relevant to agentic post-training loops, but unless the experiments are strong, just inspect the harness decomposition and provenance design.

paper.title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution

However, existing solutions generally derive self-modification from a single failure trajectory at a time, overlooking rich comparative signals available in the agent's expanding archive of past attempts. summary.core_problem: 现有自改进代码智能体每次仅基于单条失败轨迹进行自我修改，忽略了历史尝试档案中积累的丰富比较信号，导致改进效率与稳定性受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新：借鉴孟德尔遗传思想提出两类新的自修改算子，并在加性适应度景观下给出理论证明与受控仿真验证，是递归自改进智能体方向的结构化推进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM)，在传统单轨迹克隆变异基础上新增两类自修改：1) 反应规范变异：基于同一智能体在多任务上的多条轨迹同时编辑；2) 跨谱系杂交：利用其他谱系参考智能体在同一任务上的轨迹进行编辑；整体在加性适应度景观假设下进行理论分析。
summary.experiments: 通过受控代理仿真验证新策略，理论证明两类算子在加性景观下能带来更快更优的改进；摘要未披露真实代码基准（如SWE-bench）上的量化结果与基线对比。
summary.authors_note: Volker Tresp 为 LMU Munich 资深机器学习研究者，长期从事知识图谱与概率建模；Yunpu Ma 聚焦图学习与大模型推理。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-improving coding agents derive self-modifications from one failure trajectory at a time, ignoring rich comparative signals accumulated in the agent's archive of past attempts, which limits improvement efficiency and stability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces two new self-modification operators inspired by Mendelian inheritance, with theoretical proof under an additive fitness landscape and controlled simulation validation, representing structured progress in recursive self-improving agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM), which adds two self-modification strategies on top of conventional single-trajectory clonal mutation: (1) reaction-norm mutation that edits the agent using its trajectories across multiple tasks simultaneously; (2) cross-lineage hybridization that edits using trajectories from a reference agent of another lineage on the same task; provides theoretical analysis under the additive fitness landscape assumption.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the new strategies via controlled surrogate simulation and proves theoretically that they enable faster and better improvement under additive landscapes; the abstract does not report quantitative results or baselines on real coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench.
summary_en.authors_note: Volker Tresp is a senior ML researcher at LMU Munich with long-standing work on knowledge graphs and probabilistic modeling; Yunpu Ma focuses on graph learning and LLM reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 自改进代码智能体的算子设计有新意，重点读 §3 两类变异的形式化与 §5 仿真结论，真实代码基准上的有效性仍待验证，可作为内部 agent 自迭代 ablation 的参考。
recommendation.en: Novel operator design for self-improving coding agents; focus on §3 for the formalization of the two mutation types and §5 for simulation results, though real-benchmark validity remains open and it can inform internal agent self-iteration ablations.

Existing benchmarks entangle research decisions with optimization, serving, evaluation, and systems implementation, obscuring agents' research capability. We introduce RSIBench-Data, a controlled benchmark of LLM

summary.importance: 提出首个控制变量的数据中心递归自我改进基准，将数据研究能力从其他系统变量中解耦，为自动改进模型训练数据的研究提供标准化评测环境

paper.title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Under model--harness co-evolution, harnesses are not merely inference-time scaffolds but data-generating components whose execution traces can shape future foundation models. This motivates harness-in-the-loop learning: optimizing harnesses for both immediate agent performance and the quality of traces used for future model training. However, continually updating provider-built scaffolds is costly and labor-intensive. We therefore investigate whether optimizing user-constructed harnesses in a ta

summary.core_problem: 论文研究如何让固定 LLM 的 coding agent 通过递归改进 harness，在开放式代码任务中获得更高的测试时表现，而不是只增加采样次数或输出 token。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接价值有限，但对 test-time scaling、agent harness 优化、LLM-as-judge 偏好评估有启发。它把 agent 能力提升拆成两部分：模型参数不变，执行框架、提示、工具流程和评价闭环可被优化。这个视角有助于区分“模型能力不足”和“推理/执行外壳没有把能力释放出来”。对训练研究来说，更有用的问题是：这类递归 harness 搜索能否生成更高质量的 SFT/RL 轨迹，或者作为 curriculum/evaluator 的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先形式化 harness optimization。给定固定语言模型 L、coding agent A、任务 x 和 harness H，agent 输出一个代码仓库 y。由于开放式代码仓库难以用单一标量指标评估，论文采用 pairwise preference：LLM evaluator 比较两个输出在功能正确性、任务对齐、可复现性和代码质量上的优劣。目标函数是最大化某个 harness 相对参考 harness 分布的期望 pairwise win rate。Recursive Harness Self-Improvement 的思路是在这个空间里递归搜索和改写 harness，让上一轮产生的执行轨迹、代码、评价结果反过来改进下一轮 harness。它和单纯 prompt search 的区别在于优化对象更宽，可以包括工作流、工具策略、执行代码和评估组织方式；和纯 test-time 多采样的区别在于它优化生成过程，而不仅是从更多候选答案中选一个。
summary.experiments: 可见材料显示实验使用 synthetic open-ended machine learning research tasks，并用 LLM-as-a-judge 做 pairwise 评价。章节标题给出三条主要结论：few-shot RHI 能提高 test-time scaling 的性能平台；收益不能用输出 token 增加解释；few-shot RHI 通过减少 cache read/write 使用改善成本效率。消融部分还检查 RHI 是否能提高 train-time scaling 的平台、哪些 harness 因素贡献最大，以及隐式优化目标可能同时提高外部任务相关信息 f_ext、降低内部冗余或无关信息 f_int。材料未提供具体分数、成本比例、模型配置和显著性检验，不能给出数值结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。先读 2.1 的问题定义，核心是 Equation (1) 的 pairwise win-rate objective；再读 3.1 到 3.3，确认 RHI 如何定义 objective、algorithm 和 harness representation；实验部分重点看 5.3、5.4、5.5，判断性能提升是否独立于 token budget；消融看 6.2 和 6.3，尤其是 full-harness evolution 与 component evolution 的差异。Appendix B/C/E 适合查看实际 harness、optimizer prompt 和 evaluator prompt，这些细节决定方法是否可迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a coding agent with a fixed underlying LLM can improve on open-ended coding tasks by recursively optimizing its harness, rather than by only increasing sampling or output length.
summary_en.importance: The direct connection to base pretraining is limited, but the paper is relevant to test-time scaling, agent scaffolding, and preference-based evaluation. It separates model capability from the execution harness around the model. That separation is useful when diagnosing whether failures come from the base model, the prompt/workflow/tool policy, or the evaluator loop. For training research, the interesting extension is whether recursive harness search can produce better SFT or RL trajectories, or serve as an automated curriculum and evaluator generator.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes harness optimization as a pairwise preference problem. For a fixed language model L, an agent A, a task x, and a harness H, the agent produces a code repository y. Since repository-level outputs are hard to score with a single scalar metric, an LLM evaluator compares two repositories under criteria such as functional correctness, task alignment, reproducibility, and code quality. The target objective is the expected pairwise win rate of one harness against a reference distribution of competing harnesses. Recursive Harness Self-Improvement then searches and rewrites harnesses using previous executions, outputs, and evaluations as feedback. The optimized object is broader than a prompt: it may include workflow structure, tool-use policy, executable harness code, and evaluation orchestration. This differs from plain test-time sampling because the generation procedure itself changes across iterations.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied content indicates experiments on synthetic open-ended machine-learning research tasks with LLM-as-a-judge pairwise evaluation. The listed claims are that few-shot RHI raises the performance plateau of test-time scaling, that the gains are not explained by increased output-token usage, and that RHI improves cost efficiency by reducing cache read/write usage. The ablations examine whether RHI also raises train-time scaling plateaus, which harness components drive gains, and whether the implicit objective increases task-relevant external information while reducing irrelevant internal information. The provided material does not include numeric win rates, cost ratios, model settings, or significance tests, so the quantitative strength of the claims cannot be assessed from the excerpt alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is appropriate. Start with Section 2.1 and Equation (1), since the pairwise win-rate objective defines the method. Then read Sections 3.1–3.3 for the RHI objective, algorithm, and harness definition. In the experiments, focus on Sections 5.3–5.5 to check whether gains persist after controlling for token and cache budgets. In the ablations, Sections 6.2 and 6.3 are the most useful, especially the comparison between full-harness evolution and component-level evolution. Appendices B, C, and E are worth inspecting for actual harness examples, the harness optimizer prompt, and the evaluator prompt.

recommendation.zh: 把harness作为可优化的训练数据生成组件的视角很新，做Agent数据合成的值得读，setup偏合成任务需注意泛化性
recommendation.en: The framing of harness as an optimizable training data generator is novel, relevant for agent data synthesis, note limited generalization from synthetic task setup

paper.title: Recursive Self-Improvement in AI: From Bounded Self-Refinement to Autonomous Research Loops
paper.abstract: AI systems increasingly participate in their own improvement: revising their outputs, adapting their own harnesses during deployment, training on data they generate, and, increasingly, conducting AI research itself. This literature is described under a vocabulary ("self-refine," "self-reward," "self-play," "self-evolve") that conflates fundamentally different ambitions. summary.core_problem: 梳理 AI 系统参与自身改进时，不同“self-refine / self-reward / self-play / self-evolve”概念被混用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是高层分类与机制分析。它试图把有限自我修正、训练级自我改进、评估器自我改进、自动化研究循环分开，有助于讨论 self-improvement 时避免把可验证的工程循环和开放式 RSI 混在一起。
summary.technical_approach: 调研 2024-2026 年 1,250 篇 arXiv 论文，并按两个轴分类：系统改进的对象是什么，以及循环闭合程度从 human-in-the-loop 到 fully closed 的位置。分类中特别加入 self-evaluation，强调 evaluator 在闭环中的独立角色。
summary.experiments: 这是 survey/taxonomy，不是实验型论文。摘要称 bounded self-refinement 已经可收敛、可评估并进入工业实践；开放式 RSI 在 grounding、collapse dynamics 和 compute constraints 上仍受限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the overloaded vocabulary around AI self-improvement, where self-refine, self-reward, self-play, and self-evolve often refer to different loop structures.
summary_en.importance: It is a taxonomy and analysis paper. The main contribution is separating bounded self-refinement from broader recursive self-improvement, which matters for evaluating claims about autonomous model improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors survey 1,250 arXiv papers from 2024 to 2026 and classify them by what is being improved and how closed the loop is. The taxonomy explicitly includes self-evaluation as a separate category.
summary_en.experiments: There are no model-training experiments. The abstract argues that bounded self-refinement is convergent and already used in practice, while open-ended RSI remains constrained by grounding, collapse dynamics, and compute.

recommendation.zh: 当术语清理材料看即可；真正有用的是 taxonomy，别把它当自我改进可行性的实验证据。
recommendation.en: Use it as terminology cleanup; the taxonomy is useful, but it is not empirical evidence that open-ended self-improvement works.

paper.title: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: The concept of recursive self-improvement (RSI) dates back to I. J. Good (1965), where he defined an “ultraintelligent machine” as a system that can surpass humans in all intellectual activities and design better machines to improve itself. summary.core_problem: 这篇文章讨论的问题是：在模型权重之外，agent harness 如何成为自我改进系统的关键优化对象，尤其是在长时程 coding agent、auto-research 和工具使用场景中。
summary.importance: 对预训练的启发在于，它把 agent 能力拆成两层：模型本身的能力，以及模型周围的运行系统。预训练仍然决定基础能力，例如读写文件、理解代码、使用 shell、总结日志、跨步骤保持目标；但 harness 决定这些能力能否在长任务里稳定释放。这个视角会影响三类研究：agent 轨迹数据如何记录，SFT/RL 如何利用执行日志和失败案例，评测如何覆盖持久状态、后台任务和多轮自我修正。
summary.technical_approach: 文章给出的是设计模式和研究框架，不是一个新算法。核心模式有三类。第一，workflow automation：让模型在 plan、execute、observe/test、improve 的循环中工作，而不是只依赖静态 prompt。重点是让模型能分析自己的执行轨迹和失败原因，再通过 agent runtime 迭代。第二，file system as persistent memory：长任务中的代码 diff、实验日志、错误栈、论文摘要和过往轨迹不应全部塞进上下文，而应保存为文件、日志和状态记录。文件系统是简单但有效的持久记忆，因为现有 LLM 在预训练中已经学到大量 bash、代码仓库和文本文件操作模式。第三，sub-agent and backend jobs：主 agent 可以并行启动子 agent 或后台任务，用进程管理方式查看日志、取消失败任务、合并结果。文章还讨论了 harness 优化路径：从 prompt，到结构化上下文，到 workflow，到 harness code，再到 optimizer code。ACE 这类 context engineering 方法被用作例子：通过 generator、reflector、curator 维护一个可演化的 context playbook，而不是不断拉长 prompt。
summary.experiments: 没有新的实验结果或定量消融。证据主要来自对 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor-style agents、Karpathy autoresearch repo 以及 Agentic Context Engineering 等工作的归纳。文章的可用信息不是性能数字，而是工程约束：长上下文不能替代持久状态；并行子任务如果只留在聊天上下文中会变得不可检查；失败日志和中间产物需要成为 agent 可读取、可恢复、可复盘的外部状态。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 harness 定义，以及三个 design patterns：workflow automation、file system as persistent memory、sub-agent and backend jobs。coding agent harness case study 可以帮助理解为什么 IDE、shell、文件系统和测试循环比复杂 prompt 更重要。若关心预训练与后训练接口，重点看 context engineering 和 self-improving harness evolution 部分，思考这些运行轨迹如何转化为训练数据、reward 信号和 eval protocol。
summary.authors_note: Lilian Weng；OpenAI 研究员，长期写作方向包括 agent、RL、alignment、LLM 系统与自我改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The post asks how the agent harness, rather than model weights alone, becomes an optimization target for self-improving systems, especially in long-horizon coding agents, auto-research, and tool-use workflows.
summary_en.importance: The pretraining relevance comes from separating agent capability into two layers: the base model and the runtime system around it. Pretraining still determines core skills such as file editing, shell use, code understanding, log summarization, and goal maintenance across steps. The harness determines whether those skills remain usable over long tasks. This framing affects how agent trajectories should be recorded, how SFT or RL can use execution logs and failures, and how evaluations should test persistent state, background jobs, and iterative self-correction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The post is a design taxonomy rather than a new algorithm. It highlights three main patterns. First, workflow automation places the model in a plan, execute, observe/test, and improve loop, instead of relying on a static prompt. The important part is that the model can inspect its own trajectory and failures through an agent runtime. Second, file system as persistent memory argues that code diffs, experiment logs, stack traces, paper notes, and past rollouts should not all be carried in context. They should live as durable files, logs, and status records. This choice is practical because current LLMs already have strong priors for bash commands, repositories, and text-file workflows from pretraining. Third, sub-agents and backend jobs let a parent agent launch parallel attempts, monitor logs, cancel failed runs, and merge results back into the main thread. The post also sketches a progression of harness optimization targets: prompts, structured context, workflows, harness code, and eventually optimizer code. Agentic Context Engineering is used as an example of treating context as an evolving playbook maintained by generator, reflector, and curator components, rather than as an ever-growing prompt.
summary_en.experiments: No new quantitative experiments or ablations are presented. The evidence is qualitative, drawing on systems such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor-style agents, Karpathy's autoresearch repo, and Agentic Context Engineering. The useful observations are engineering constraints: long context does not remove the need for durable state; parallel subtask outputs become hard to inspect if they exist only in chat history; failure logs and intermediate artifacts need to be readable, recoverable external state.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough; budget about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the definition of a harness and the three design patterns: workflow automation, file-system memory, and sub-agent or backend-job management. The coding-agent case study is useful for seeing why IDE access, shell commands, files, and tests often matter more than prompt complexity. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the most relevant parts are context engineering and self-improving harness evolution, especially how these runtime traces could become training data, reward signals, or evaluation protocols.
summary_en.authors_note: Lilian Weng; OpenAI researcher, known for technical writing on agents, reinforcement learning, alignment, LLM systems, and self-improvement.

recommendation.zh: 把 RSI 从玄学概念落到 pretrain→posttrain→deployment 的可操作闭环上，重点读训练管线自举那一节即可。
recommendation.en: Grounds RSI from an abstract concept to an actionable pretrain→posttrain→deployment closed loop; focus on the training-pipeline bootstrapping section.

paper.title: The Red Queen Gödel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
paper.abstract: Self-improving agents are state-of-the-art (SOTA) on agentic coding benchmarks and have recently been extended to general domains. However, their search methods generally assume a stationary evaluation criterion: a fixed verifier, benchmark, or labeled dataset that remains valid as the agent improves. This ignores a central feature of evolution: species adapt as their environments change with them. We aim to bring the same principle to recursive self-improvement, making evaluation part of the im

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是自改进智能体对固定外部评测的依赖：当任务没有直接 benchmark、评测成本高、静态 benchmark 饱和，或评测信号容易被利用时，现有 Gödel Machine 类搜索很难继续扩展。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 post-train、agentic RL、自动数据生成和评测信号设计有参考意义。它关注的是“生成器和评价器共同演化”这类闭环训练问题。这个问题也会出现在推理数据合成、自动 verifier、AI judge、reward model 迭代中：如果评价器固定，系统会过拟合；如果评价器随意变化，优化目标又会不稳定。
summary.technical_approach: RQGM 把搜索过程切成多个 evaluator epoch。每个 epoch 内，评价器冻结，任务 agent 只面对一个固定 utility，因此仍可沿用已有自改进搜索的分析框架。epoch 边界处，系统会并行训练 challenger evaluator，并用 held-out ground-truth 数据检验它是否显著优于当前 evaluator。只有通过统计检验后，challenger 才替换 incumbent。替换后，系统执行 selective erasure，只删除依赖旧 evaluator 打分的 utility 记录，而不是清空整个 archive。这个设计的关键取舍是：允许 utility 演化，但只在边界处演化，避免每一步都在移动目标上优化。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个方向做了初步实验：代码、论文写作/评审、证明写作/评分。代码任务中，加入 co-evolved code reviewer 后，RQGM 在 Polyglot 上达到 71.7% held-out pass rate，此前 HGM-H 为 69.9%，并以约 1.35× 到 1.72× 更少的 search token 超过基线水平。论文写作任务中，co-evolved writer 的 acceptance rate 从此前方法的 21.8% 提高到 40.5%。证明评分任务中，co-evolved grader 以约 3× 更低 search cost 超过静态 evaluator 基线。论文还观察到 evaluator 变强后会重新排序 archive，形成类似 curriculum 的效果；对过度接受 AI 生成论文的 reviewer，可通过在后续 epoch 回放 adversarial samples 来降低偏置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 fixed evaluation 局限的定义，Sec. 3 的 controlled utility evolution 和 selective erasure，Fig. 1 中 search token 与 pass rate 的关系，以及 Fig. 3、Fig. 4 关于 evaluator replacement 后 archive 重排的现象。若关注 AI judge 或 reward model 迭代，可以再看 Sec. 5.4 的 adversarial evaluator regularization。证明部分和具体 agent 框架实现可按需跳读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of self-improving agents: current Gödel Machine-style systems rely on a fixed external evaluator, which becomes problematic when direct benchmarks are unavailable, expensive, saturated, or easy to exploit.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not directly about base-model pretraining, but it is relevant to post-training loops, agentic RL, synthetic data generation, and learned evaluation. The central issue is also present in reward models, AI judges, verifier training, and reasoning-data pipelines: a fixed evaluator can be overfit, while a freely changing evaluator makes optimization unstable.
summary_en.technical_approach: RQGM divides search into evaluator epochs. Within each epoch, the evaluator is frozen, so the task-agent search still optimizes a stationary utility. In parallel, challenger evaluators are evolved and tested on held-out ground-truth data. A challenger replaces the incumbent only if it statistically improves an ε-best-belief score. After replacement, the system applies selective erasure: it removes only archived utility records that depended on the displaced evaluator. The main design choice is to permit non-stationary utilities only at controlled epoch boundaries, rather than letting the reward signal drift continuously.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers coding, paper writing/reviewing, and proof writing/grading. On Polyglot coding tasks, adding a co-evolved code reviewer yields a 71.7% held-out pass rate, compared with 69.9% for the prior HGM-H baseline, while requiring about 1.35× to 1.72× fewer search tokens to exceed the baseline level. In paper writing, co-evolved writers raise the acceptance rate from 21.8% to 40.5%. In proof grading, a co-evolved grader outperforms static evaluator baselines at roughly 3× lower search cost. The paper also reports archive re-ranking after evaluator replacement and shows that adversarial replay can reduce an evaluator’s over-acceptance of AI-generated papers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the Introduction for the fixed-evaluator failure modes, Section 3 for controlled utility evolution and selective erasure, Figure 1 for the cost-quality tradeoff, and Figures 3 and 4 for archive re-ranking across evaluator epochs. Readers working on AI judges or reward model iteration may also want to inspect Section 5.4 on adversarial evaluator regularization. The formal guarantee details and implementation specifics can be read selectively.

recommendation.zh: 读方法框架即可；若实验证据薄，就把它当 verifier/curriculum 共演化的概念种子。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework; if evidence is thin, treat it as a concept seed for co-evolving verifiers and curricula.
